title: Commutation Discount Spread by Remaining Certain Term — Income Annuities Rate Card
content:
The commutation discount spread used when a beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract commutes the remaining certain installments is set by the whole months remaining from the election to the certain period end date:

| Whole months from the election to the certain period end date | Commutation discount spread |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 24 (the short months) | Short spread: **0.5% (0.0050)** |
| 180 (the long months) or more | Long spread: **1.5% (0.0150)** |
| 24 to 179 | Neither of these spreads applies |

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** 23 months remaining: 0.5%. 24 months: neither. 179 months: neither. 180 months: 1.5%.

**Effect on the combined rate (hypothetical pricing interest rate 4.25%).** With 20 months left the pricing rate plus the spread is 4.75%; with 200 months left it is 5.75%.
